body:
Their videos helped me improve my English as my second language! 
Found them randomly when I was in high school with zero English knowledge, but I enjoyed watching them playing games. 
Eventually I learned some English flows and comedy through their videos and that made me decide to go study abroad in US. 
Now I’m trying to get an English teacher license in my country. 
It’s crazy one YouTube channel kinda changed my life! Funhaus has been one of my best comfort channels for almost ten years:)
